name: Lauren Young Tire

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large commercial building with a flat white roof and multiple service bays|Extensive paved parking areas surround the structure and hold numerous vehicles|Large outdoor storage areas contain stacked tires|The property is located in an industrial area near a major highway and open fields.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main commercial building with service bays and storefront windows facing a paved parking lot|Signage for the tire center is visible|Multiple vehicles are parked in marked spaces|Outdoor tire storage is present near the building.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side elevation of the commercial building and portions of the paved parking area|Service bays and outdoor storage of tires are visible|Vehicles and circulation space continue along this side.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back of the commercial building with additional service areas|Large outdoor storage of stacked tires occupies significant portions of the rear lot|Vehicles and open paved space are present.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the commercial building and paved parking areas|Outdoor tire storage and service vehicles are present|Circulation lanes continue around this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from multiple points via the large paved parking and circulation areas that surround the building. The parking lot provides substantial space for emergency vehicle staging and movement. Outdoor storage of large quantities of tires occupies significant portions of the site. Multiple vehicles currently occupy parking and service areas. The industrial layout allows relatively clear movement around the main building, though tire storage areas may require additional navigation awareness.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking areas, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the building? Are there multiple points of entry into the service bays and main building? Is vehicle access available on all sides of the facility? What is the primary use and storage arrangement of the outdoor tire areas on the property?
